notes.title: Rusty Lake: Roots is 66% OFF in our Rusty Lake Anniversary Steam Sale! 🎊
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009977/85101fe90af9f7530ffd1c19793018841c016d64.jpg[/img]

[h3]Happy 10 years of Rusty Lake![/h3] 🥳 And what better way to celebrate a decade of Rusty Lake than with:

[list]
[*] [b]A new free-to-play game: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show [/b]- hat tricks, sleight of hand, and a few unexpected reveals you don’t want to miss; 
[*] An early look at our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/]premium Rusty Lake game[/url]
[*] And special Rusty Lake anniversary merch in collaboration with Lost in Cult - available to pre-order right now;
[*] A week-long platform-wide discounts of up to[b] 66% OFF on all our premium games[/b], including hosting our very own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RustyLakePublisherSale]Rusty Lake Anniversary Steam Sale Page[/url]
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rustylakepublishersale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26608424/0506a0d718efeb80a6099b5136e5f7897e9a9acf.png[/img][/url]

Of course, the sale includes [b]Rusty Lake: Roots[/b], which you can now download and play for [b]66% off[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/532110/Rusty_Lake_Roots/

And don't forget to check out our [b]new magical puzzle game: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show[/b]. A free-to-play short but magical game filled with enough secrets and unexpected twists to put you in a celebratory mood!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472550/The_Mr_Rabbit_Magic_Show/

Keep an eye out for secrets while playing The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show, and you might just find an early look at our next Rusty Lake adventure! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/]Wishlist now[/url] to stay up to date!

[url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/rustylake][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26608424/79fc9db394a84f82d17eecccf67771e750806427.png[/img][/url]

As a special thank-you for your continued support over the past 10 years, we’re excited to further delight you with some special Rusty Lake anniversary merch in collaboration with Lost in Cult available to pre-order as of today, April 30th:

[list]
[*] 🎵 Rusty Lake: [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/rustylake]Sounds of the Lake 10th Anniversary Vinyl Collection[/url] - 20 of Rusty Lake’s Greatest Hits performed by Victor Butzelaar. 
[*] 🃏 A mysterious [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/rustylake]deck of cards[/url] (perfect for your own magic tricks) - designed by Maarten Pelders, inspired by the series’ surreal symbols and characters.
[*] 📖 A re-launch of our fan-favourite [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/rustylake]Paradox Comic Book[/url] by Lau Kwong Shing 
[/list]
Whether you’ve been a part of our Rusty Lake universe since the first launch of a Cube Escape title back in 2015, or you’ve joined our journey during our later years, we’d like to share a heartfelt Thank you! from the whole Rusty Lake team!
 
Thanks to you and your incredible support, we’ve had an amazing 10 years, and we’re as excited as ever to continue exploring the mysteries of Rusty Lake with more video games, short films, tablet-top experiences and much more! We hope you’ll stick around for what’s to come!

The past is never dead.

notes.title: The Cube Escape Collection is now available! 🎉
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33593611/cf0f6f168ff467c1a553bc23068435a1e744ffc6.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

We’re very excited to finally release a Collection of the first nine Cube Escape chapters on Steam to survive the end of the Flash Games era:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection/

We hope you will be happy to finally have all these games in one place where you can easily revisit the Rusty Lake universe and unlock all the 72 new achievements! There is also a new hint system and our translators did a tremendous job adding translations to all of them.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UTKfF1K1MUg

We are celebrating this much-awaited release with a sale, as a small thank you to all of you for the amazing support you’ve shown us over the years. When we released our first Cube Escape game, Seasons, 5 years ago we never dreamed we would attract such an amazing community. To this day we’re still blown away by your continuous support and kind words. Thank you for being such a big part of the Rusty Lake journey!

Good luck finding all the achievements and please stay tuned for future Rusty Lake updates!

Thanks for your support! The past is never dead 🦐

Rusty Lake

Important:
- We really appreciate your feedback! Feel free to leave a review in the store!
- Any bugs/glitches? Please let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/rustylake]Discord[/url] or at support@rustylake.com.
- All our games (including The White Door) are on 50% sale as well for today - please keep an eye on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/rustylake]Steam page[/url]!
- The Collection contains 9 chapters: Seasons, The Lake, Arles, Harvey's Box, Case 23, The Mill, Birthday, Theatre and The Cave. Paradox will be available separately.
- These games do not contain any new content from their original versions (besides achievements, a new hint system and translations)!

notes.title: Rusty Lake: Roots Achievements are now available and more news!
notes.content:
[h1] Achievements [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26608424/9118668e76fa676378a757c102f9f6c4f8c7de64.png[/img]

We're very happy to announce that we finally got the long-awaited Steam achievements working for Rusty Lake: Roots. We choose a total of 16 different achievements for you to unlock. Downside is that we are a bit afraid that your progress will be lost when you update the game; this happened before with previous updates and we don't have a solution for this yet. 
Sorry you guys needed to wait so long for us to add the Steam achievements... It was a big technical challenge for both the Windows and Mac version. We hope it all works now correctly, if you encounter any issue, please email us at info@rustylake.com

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26608424/186c70a635491b47734fadabb3f3b47ec775d7c8.png[/img]

[h1] The Cave and a new Premium project [/h1]

Next to this we are continuously working on new content. At te end of March we launched a new free game in the series: 
[url=http://www.rustylake.com/room-escape-games/cube-escape-the-cave.html]Cube Escape: The Cave[/url]. It has a lot of connections with Roots and you can find out more what is happening in Rusty Lake. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26608424/153d3ab2b0f464ca1852114fcc86b1d5b2ac1e9a.png[/img]

We are now working on a bigger premium game again, which we are very excited about, stay tuned for updates on our [url=http://blog.rustylake.com/second-update-about-our-new-project/]blog[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26608424/d2ac932a1d1119ba0a002057bec6c735a2febf62.png[/img]

[h1]Rusty Lake Hotel & Roots Bundle [/h1]

We also made a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3669/Rusty_Lake_Bundle/]bundle[/url] available for both Rusty Lake Hotel and Rusty Lake: Roots, if don't have both games you can buy them now as a bundle with a 15% discount. 

[h1]Store languages [/h1]

Not but not least we added 14 languages for the store, if you see an error in your language, please let us know :) 

Thanks for your support !!
